Presenting the full video song "Kaavaan Kaavaan" in the voice of Divya Kumar, lyrics by Kumaar, Re-arranged by Arjunna Harjaie from the movie “Lucknow Central”. Originally composed by Sukhwinder Singh and Mychael Danna. Produced by Viacom18 Motion Pictures, Monisha Advani, Madhu G Bhojwani & Nikkhil Advani. Directed by Ranjit Tiwari and written by Aseem Arora. It features Farhan Akhtar, Diana Penty, Gippy Grewal, Ronit Roy, Deepak Dobriyal, InaamUlHaq & Rajesh Sharma in the lead roles.
